context_for_next_testing_agent: Gym Design bug fix verified. Key features: 1) Snap-to-grid toggle button shows 'Snap X.Xm' label and is cyan when active. 2) Grid size dropdown appears when snap is enabled with 0.25m, 0.5m, 1m options. 3) Equipment markers are proportionally sized rectangles based on 30m×20m gym dimensions. 4) PDF uploads are converted to PNG by backend (poppler-utils). 5) Equipment positions are saved correctly with center-to-topleft offset fix. 6) Spacing warnings appear between close/overlapping machines (tested but snap-to-grid prevents most overlaps). 7) Existing iGym Congleton layout with 11 equipment items loads correctly.
